observations.contract: Captured CodeGraph snapshots preserve framework, conformance, deferred and negative graph behavior against stock disk indexing
Existing-store public syncSnapshots edits preserve untouched graph state and equal a fresh indexed build
Authoritative captured source and metadata remain pure when live tsconfig, go.mod, and workspace package files are mutated or deleted
live_mutations: changed and deleted workspace package files
observations.stock_sdk_without_captured_map: normal CodeGraph indexed initialization still sees stockSdk

observations.contract: Public unified graph sync/query handles a multipart source publication and late framework manifest
observations.framework_manifest: package.json added after the large source set and after the warm publication

review_fix.empty_snapshot: Defined empty source snapshots reach the graph worker and public graph query returns a clean empty result after deleting the last source.
review_fix.multipart: Prepared graph parts are staged until the final marker; a late package.json framework marker is observed in the complete multipart publication.
review_fix.snapshot_purity: Resolver source reads, directory enumeration, file existence, aliases, go.mod, and workspace package metadata use the authoritative captured map.
review_fix.directory_import: A captured src/mod/index.js import remains resolved to the captured module despite a live-only src/mod.js competitor, with the expected import/call edge matching a fresh captured graph.
review_fix.stock_compatibility: A normal CodeGraph indexed initialization without captured snapshots remains filesystem-backed.
